title: Search, scan and filter ownership across tasks
detail: Farrowing, Inspection and Home each provide a scoped Find, Scan and Filter route. Farrowing's Find searches every unit; its single-action Scan opens one record per read, while Choose pigs scanning ticks eligible reads. Their screens use shared Lookup and Row components but task-specific content and filters. Whether their future search and scan flows should have one feature owner remains open. The 2026-11-17 Farrowing consistency round settled its own entrance and screen mismatches; it did not decide that cross-task ownership question.
options: Keep task-specific routes with shared components
Make one shared search and scan feature with task scope
Use Home search and scan as the only doors; tasks keep filters
